svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: 32 dots run down the page for chapters 1 to 32, grouped on the left into the parts with their names. Every dot except chapter 1 and the hollow ones receives one arrow, an arc bulging to the right, from the chapter it refers back to most; the thicker the arrow, the more mentions. Chapter 1 sends 6 (to chapters 2, 5, 9, 18, 23, 28); chapter 3 sends 4 (to chapters 4, 10, 19, 21); chapter 2 sends 2 (to chapters 3, 7). Chapter 11 is a hollow dot with no arrow.
